newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: BTC 96 pretax seen up over eight pct.
newsitem.headline: BTC 96 pretax seen up over eight pct.

text.p: Slovenian warehousing company BTC on Wednesday forecast it would raise its 1996 pre-tax profit by between eight to 10 percent.

"It is too soon to release exact figures as our accounts are not finished yet, but our estimates vary between an eight to 10 percent increase from 804 million tolars ($5.36 million) in 1995," Anka Bezak, chief accountant at BTC said.
The company's profit was up mainly due to increased sales pushed up by new warehousing capacity, she noted.
BTC's sales in 1996 jumped to 4.42 billion tolars from 3.68 billion, a 20 percent increase from the previous year.
The company paid a dividend of 900 tolars per share.
On Wednesday shares of BTC were traded 0.39 percent higher at 12,990 tolars on volume of 257 shares.
